name: P3 generalization: the chain taught under four weathers, read under four it never met
credit: Will Glynn, cadence-teachers EXP-48 (https://github.com/WGlynn/cadence-teachers): three irrelevant weather bits, teaching under the even-parity combinations and testing under the odd-parity ones
question: On fresh founders, with and without the episodic memory: does a chain taught under four weathers hold under four weathers it never met, stage by stage, or did the brain record the taught situations?
scope: invariance to irrelevant features in unseen combinations; the inventory takes the same four values at test as in teaching, so this is not a new recipe or a longer chain

world.note: V5's chain with three weather bits after its seven inputs, fixed for an episode and irrelevant to every rule; lives draw from the even-parity weathers, frozen evaluations cycle through the odd-parity ones
